criteria.rationale: The patient was 49 on the September 1, 2026 request date.
The request is for chronic weight management, and the August note plans Wegovy for obesity.
Notes within 180 days document ongoing dietary changes, but neither documents increased physical activity alongside Wegovy.
The notes document dietary changes and follow-up from December through August, but do not establish participation in a program that includes increased physical activity.
The latest structured BMI before the request is 33.5 kg/m², exceeding the 30 kg/m² threshold.

missing_requirements: Documentation of increased physical activity alongside Wegovy within 180 days before the request.
Documentation that a continuous weight-management program included increased physical activity for at least six months before drug therapy.
parsed.summary: Age, indication, and BMI meet policy requirements. Dietary changes and follow-up are documented, but increased physical activity is not documented for either the planned adjunct treatment or the six-month program.
